status: Method development only. All previous test results remain sealed for this candidate family.
input_policy: Saved frozen full-abstract and isolated-sentence scores. For the external datasets, only fitting IDs saved before the previous external test are used. No external development/test outcomes are read.
family: Compare binary logistic gradient boosting with a pairwise logistic surrogate for partial AUC over the highest-scoring 5% or 20% of training negatives. All losses use the same tree capacity and full-context versus dual-context feature ablation.
weights: Equal total weight per claim and available pool. Positive and negative weights are normalized separately in the pairwise loss.
folds: Four deterministic source-component folds. Each development prediction is made by a model fitted without that component. Smoke evaluates fold zero only, on the previously inspected SciFact development data.
metric: Mean precision over candidate pools at exactly 100 admitted sentences per 100 claims, at most five per claim. Tie keys are fixed and independent of annotations.
matched_controls: Raw full rationale, full product, isolated rationale, three arithmetic blends, existing histogram calibrators of depths two and three, and matching full-context gradient boosters with every new objective.
smoke_gate: Finite, label/order-invariant scores; exact workload; nonzero positive/negative mass; numerical directional derivative check for the fixed-tail pairwise loss. Continue only if some dual-context new model exceeds the best raw control and is within 0.005 of existing dual-context calibration.
stopping: One smoke and at most one four-fold development run for this family. Retain every candidate result. Development selection alone cannot authorize a confirmatory manuscript claim; further validation must use a newly specified independent evaluation.
